text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Hey, Desire-chan, it sounds pretty 
noisy over there, desu ne—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yo, let's renovate the cafeteria into a 
martial arts arena! Bring about the end of 
the century!! Hey, fetch the shoulder 
pads!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ummm, about that... I wonder. I feel like 
a sliiiightly calmer atmosphere might be 
better, but...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Wah, it looks so lively...! What is 
everyone doing together, desu ka?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
『Today is Stego-san's welcome-back party. 
Since she's finally coming home... we're 
all preparing to make it something truly 
special!』

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
My, how wonderful! Might I be permitted to 
lend a hand as well?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Now then... around here should do nicely, 
right? For setting up Big Sis's golden 
statue.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!? A golden statue... of Ste-Go-san!?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes... It's custom-made by Orfe. I'm 
certain Big Sis will be the most pleased 
of all.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Umu. —With this gold, We shall display Our 
majesty to the rest.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
A welcome? Entertaining someone? That's 
boring as hell. That's right... gotta have 
that thrilling edge on the line.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If I drop even one of these— I won't eat a 
single bite at this party!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
What an excruciating trial...! Even though 
it's supposed to be a welcome party...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Nah... still not enough. Should I juggle 
with raw eggs instead...?!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Wha-!? A-As expected of you, 
Nakayama-san...!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"When I say 'Why you gotta say that?!'... 
smack my head with a pop! Please, don't 
hold back at all!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I-I can't do that to ya, Marche-chan! I 
don't even know which one of us is 
supposed to be the straight man!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Are you two, um... practicing a comedy 
routine?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ah... yeah. We were thinkin' of givin' 
Ste-Go-san a good laugh, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"We're going to make Ste-Go-san laugh so, 
so much! Enough to make her so glad she 
came back!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...How wonderful. Everyone is eagerly 
awaiting Ste-Go-san's return.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Yes, exactly as you say. ...However—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Excessive behavior is strictly 
prohibited!! This officer shall maintain 
the utmost vigilance, sir!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, with Fenomeno-san around, we have 
nothing to worry about! ...I wonder what 
kind of face Ste-Go-san will make?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm looking forward to her arrival. 
...Oh, my?

One day, hearing a commotion in the 
cafeteria, I went to check on the 
situation—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Flawless juggling! To think you 
wouldn't drop a single one.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
And... Lala and Marche, you guys were 
great too. Do that comedy routine with me 
later, alright?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Once it's all done, let's take a photo in 
front of the statue. Seriously, you guys 
made something really awesome!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ste-Go-san's smile is so wonderful! I'm so 
glad everyone's hard work paid off...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Everyone's prayers have reached 
her... What a truly magnificent moment!
